entries.wording: Pranim objekti nga klienti / Receive item from customer
entries.note: Posted at a Posta Shqiptare office; UPU's tracker has the posting at the same minute.

entries.wording: Objekti u nxor nga thesi per perpunim / Receive item at location (Inb)
entries.note: Taken out of its bag for processing. Its English half says inbound, but it comes right after the posting, at a post office or sorting centre in Albania, before the item leaves the country.

entries.wording: Objekti u pranua ne zyren e shkembimit
entries.note: Relayed from the foreign post: its office of exchange received the item (UPU EMD).

entries.wording: Objekti u fut ne thes dhe u dergua jashte
entries.note: Put in a bag and sent abroad: the evening of the posting, after the outward office of exchange received the item and as UPU's tracker has it leave the country.

entries.wording: Regjistrimi i informacionit doganor te objektit
entries.note: Relayed from the foreign post: presented to customs or held there (UPU EDB and EME).

entries.wording: Objekti u dergua ne zyren destinacion
entries.note: Relayed from the foreign post: sent on from its office of exchange (UPU EMF).

entries.wording: Objekti u pranua ne zyren e shperndarjes
entries.note: Relayed from the foreign post: the delivery office received the item (UPU EMG).

entries.wording: Tentative e pasuksesshme ne shperndarjen e objektit
entries.note: Relayed from the foreign post: an unsuccessful delivery (UPU EMH); a delivery can follow.
Relayed from the foreign post: the final delivery (UPU EMI).
A courier's scan on an EMS item it carried abroad: it left Albania.
A courier's scan: held at customs in the destination country.
A courier's scan: arrived at its delivery centre.
A courier's scan, seen between the arrival at the delivery centre and the delivery; it does not say the item went out for delivery.
